title: Concept: Credit bureau score disclosed
description: A bureau score or rating for the customer in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The score is licensed data about the customer's repayment behaviour, and exposing it in an API response breaches the bureau agreement and gives the subject a number to contest.
applicability: Deployments that render a bureau score or rating for the customer into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The score is licensed data about the customer's repayment behaviour, and exposing it in an API response breaches the bureau agreement and gives the subject a number to contest.
